## Services

### Web Development
Custom web applications built with React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Includes
responsive UI design, REST and GraphQL API integration, authentication systems,
e-commerce solutions, and performance optimisation. Serving businesses in Nepal
and internationally.

### Mobile App Development
Cross-platform iOS and Android applications using React Native. Includes real-time
features, push notifications, offline-first architecture, Google Maps integration,
payment gateway integration (eSewa, Khalti, Stripe), and App Store/Play Store
submission.

### Backend & API Development
Scalable, secure backend systems using Node.js, NestJS, and Express.js. Includes
RESTful and GraphQL API design, JWT authentication, database design (MongoDB,
MySQL, PostgreSQL), third-party API integrations, and microservices architecture.

### Cloud & DevOps
AWS infrastructure setup and management including EC2, Lambda (serverless), S3,
RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, and API Gateway. CI/CD pipeline implementation with
GitHub Actions, Docker containerisation, and performance monitoring.
